desc:
🧱 PUNCH WALLS TO ESCAPE 🧱

The guard tossed you into solitary with nothing but your fists. The only way out is THROUGH the wall!

👊 PUNCH the walls apart block by block
🌀 VACUUM up the rubble and dump it in the Bottomless Bucket for cash
⬆️ UPGRADE your fists and vacuum, then unlock chisels, pickaxes, jackhammers and DYNAMITE
🏃 DIG your tunnel all the way to freedom!

👥 BREAK OUT WITH FRIENDS
Step into a cell in the prison yard and team up with up to 4 players.

📋 CHOOSE YOUR SENTENCE
- Easy: a short dig
- Normal: a longer dig
- Hard: the longest dig (escape on Normal to unlock)

😤 CHAPTER 2: BIG TONY
Your new cellmate is HUGE and he wants out too. Dig him a door big enough to fit through!
